en.title: Collect Coins by Jumping Three Cells Right
en.description:
The board consists of . (empty cells), T (pieces), and C (coins). In each step, choose a piece and jump it exactly three cells to the right; the landing cell must be on the board and must not hold another piece. A coin on the landing cell is collected and does not appear again. Find the maximum number of coins that can be collected.

The input format, examples, and test data are compiled and written by CSWork.
en.input: A board string of length 1..100, consisting only of ., T, C.
en.output: Output the answer as described; multiple results are separated by spaces, in order.
en.explanation: The example inputs and outputs follow the rules above directly; see the solution for the full algorithm.
hints: Split the indices by their value modulo 3 into three independent chains. In each chain, only count the coins to the right of the leftmost piece.
